name: obsidian-canvas-utilities
description: Focused authoring and workflow utilities for Obsidian Canvas.

scripts.format: biome format --write main.ts manifest.json package.json tsconfig.json esbuild.config.mjs biome.json styles.css
scripts.lint: biome lint main.ts manifest.json package.json tsconfig.json esbuild.config.mjs biome.json styles.css
scripts.check: biome check main.ts manifest.json package.json tsconfig.json esbuild.config.mjs biome.json styles.css && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run check && pnpm run bundle

author: ibbuilds
